name: WSM v1 Augustus official recommended dense Channel Heads
method_identity: WSM Channel Heads are routed task modules within TunnelingNet. PEFT-compatible checkpoint filenames describe the storage backend, not the identity or capability of the method.
project_root_contract: All model paths are relative to WSM_v1.

policy.primary: Freeze the exact dense runs used by the complete 1,148-Head evaluation. Sparse and custom recommendations live directly in their compact modality configuration files.
policy.missing_imported_run: For imported evaluation runs absent locally, freeze one contract-compatible canonical-coverage run now; future evaluation must not rediscover it silently.
policy.update: Edit or regenerate this reviewed file explicitly when an official Head changes.
